name: Haus Rosmarie
beschreibung: The inn Haus Rosmarie is located in Neustift im Stubaital, surrounded by the mountain landscape of the Stubaier Alpen. The rooms are equipped with a bathroom, WC, cable TV and some with a balcony; free Wi-Fi is available. In the restaurant, traditional Tiroler dishes and seasonal specialties are served. A breakfast buffet and, on request, half board complete the offering. In summer, the surroundings are ideal for hikes and mountain tours. In winter, ski areas and the nearby Stubaier Gletscher are available. The location allows for a wide range of leisure activities year-round. The house is family-run and is characterized by a cozy atmosphere.
